name: Fate
overview: Scripture reveals that what some call 'fate' is ultimately under the sovereign guidance of God, who ordains and directs the steps of His people according to His perfect will. While humans may plan their own way, it is the Lord who establishes their path and purposes, as seen in Proverbs 16:9 and Jeremiah 1:5. God's knowledge and plans for us precede our existence, offering an expected and hopeful end (Jeremiah 29:11), even though certain things, like the exact timing of future events, remain known only to the Father (Mark 13:32). Believers can therefore trust in God's comforting presence and guidance through life's uncertainties, as Psalm 23:4 affirms.
